elaine_cs: FYI prepping NebulaTek QBR for Fri. Onboarding roughly 60% but renewal conversation also on the table — cost is a big risk item. Can ops & finance give a 5-min snapshot we can paste in the deck?
ryan_se: I can pull a short usage summary. Quick glance: last 30d tokens ~12.4M, spike yesterday from a bulk import job. Embedding calls are 48% of tokens.
priya_pm: Product comment: they turned on long-context summarization and a nightly backfill. Those backfills likely caused the spike. They value the summarization heavily — we should propose controls that keep functionality but reduce cost.
amir_finops: I'll run a cost sensitivity. Initial thoughts: quantized model variant + smaller embedding model for similarity checks = ~35% savings without UX hit. Also suggest enabling daily budget digest emails (they only have admin webhook).
notify-bot: Alert: NebulaTek (acct 8872) - 7-day projected spend = $11,600. Alert threshold set = $10,000 (notify webhook only).
elaine_cs: Good catch. Priya, can you outline 2 rollback-safe config options for the QBR? Ryan, can you give the raw numbers and highlight the backfill timeframe. Amir, please recommend a soft cap value.
ryan_se: Raw numbers pasted: `30d tokens=12.4M -> cost=$11.6k; backfill window: 2026-02-04 01:00-03:30 UTC; embedding calls during backfill = 1.9M tokens`. Also note batch_size parameter was set to 8 in the backfill job.
priya_pm: Two config change options:
1) Throttle backfill: limit batch_size 8->2 and parallelism 12->4 (low risk, 25-40% cost drop).
2) Hybrid embed policy: route near-duplicate checks to em-slim-v1 and only run full embed for top-K candidates (40-60% embed token cut).
amir_finops: Scenario estimates (very rough): `baseline: 12.4M -> $11.6k`; `throttle backfill: 9.4M -> $8.8k`; `hybrid embeds: 7.8M -> $6.9k`; `both changes: 5.5M -> $4.9k`. Recommend soft cap = $9,000 to give buffer but trigger CS outreach at $8k.
elaine_cs: That soft cap makes sense. For renewal risk, let's include a slide that trades feature value vs cost with those three scenarios. Priya please mock a 1-slide UX/ops playbook.
ryan_se: Quick runbook snippet to include in appendix:
```
- Before nightly backfill: set BATCH_SIZE=2, MAX_PARALLEL=4
- Use KV prefix caching for repeated summaries
- Switch embed model in similarity pipeline to em-slim-v1 with fallback to em-base-v2
- Monitor daily token delta and auto-pause backfill at 120% of daily baseline
```
priya_pm: I'll draft the playbook slide + a customer-facing recommendation email. Also will capture the hallucination feedback they gave on 8k+ token docs and add a short diagnostic plan.
amir_finops: I enabled daily budget digest for acct 8872 (to their billing-email) and set a soft_limit=$9,000, hard_throttle at 110% of projected daily rate. Also added an opt-in for auto-throttle on scheduled backfills.
elaine_cs: Nice. Action items: 1) Ryan finalize numbers and screenshot of backfill trace, 2) Priya produce the slide + email draft, 3) Amir confirm the digest landed and set the soft cap, 4) I'll own the renewal slide and outreach note. Quick sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. :rocket:
